steps.name: Akyung's Letter
steps.objective: Go to "Yong Gyoung" and talk to Akyung.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Welcome! Thank you for coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. What favor did you want to ask?

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: It's about the Dragon Emperor's Palace here in Yong Gyoung.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: She says she's fine and still has strength to spare, but she looked exhausted.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: I couldn't keep watching, so I contacted you, %s. Even if she scolds me for acting on my own, it couldn't be helped.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: I've kept hearing about your achievements, %s.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: I decided this was the time we needed your strength, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for thinking so highly of me. I'm curious what happened. Could you explain?

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: As you may know, %s...

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Here in Yong Gyoung, there is a vast palace isolated within a powerful spatial barrier.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: The Dragon Emperor's Palace...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I vaguely remember it.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: The spatial barrier isolating the palace is called, if I recall...

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: [Stopped Time]...

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: One of the Great Miracle Secret Arts, which separates a designated place from space and time.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: While the barrier remains, nobody can enter, and nothing inside can escape.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: That's because time in the isolated space comes to a halt.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: It was a secret art usable only by exceptionally gifted descendants of the Dragon Emperor, founder of the Yong Gyoung Empire.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: But recently, the palace's barrier broke.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: The Yong Gyoung troops, trapped in stopped time for four hundred years, awakened and began moving again.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Four hundred years...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: No, nothing. It just makes my heart feel heavy...

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Anyway, the Yong Gyoung army is dangerous. The Dragon Emperor, who made them what they are, has become an even more wicked demon.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: An emperor who rejected humanity for power, and an army he forcibly strengthened with demonic power... Honestly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we need to stop them.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Yes. We must fight the forces inside the Dragon Emperor's Palace.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: Follow the path through the Red Crop Field that appears only late at night, and you'll meet her.

lines.speaker: 아경
lines.text: We desperately need your help, %s. Please don't turn away. Go to the 'Red Crop Field (Midnight)'!

steps.name: The Dragon Emperor's Palace Rises Again
steps.objective: Go to the "Red Crop Field (Midnight)" and talk to Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: You are...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. I'm %s. Akyung asked me to come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you the commander here? Of the forces fighting the Yong Gyoung army...?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: So you've heard some of the situation.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Yes. I command the Jiendia Imperial Army... My name is Jiendia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Jiendia Empire?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Our empire once stood at the heart of the Jiendia continent. Now it quietly survives in one corner of it.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I came here to sever an old, bitter bond. My bond with the Dragon Emperor...

lines.speaker: 제국 정규군 1
lines.text: Your Majesty! The Tiger Immortal from the Tiger Temple has just arrived! She has already entered the Dragon Emperor's Palace!

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: So the Tiger Immortal has finally arrived...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Soldier, tell the deployed troops to follow Lady Leilei's instructions.

lines.speaker: 제국 정규군 1
lines.text: By your command!

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Now that she's here, we can hope nothing goes wrong. Ah, where was I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: You're surprised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a little... When I heard your name, I thought it was unusual. So you really are...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Please be at ease with me.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I've heard much about you, %s.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Thank you for facing so many dangers for people's safety and the continent's peace. Shall we get to the matter at hand?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (As Jiendia steadies her breathing, the atmosphere around her seems to change.)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Four hundred years ago, Yong Gyoung's downfall began with a conflict between the Dragon Emperor, ruler of the empire, and his son, Crown Prince Guiyi.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: At some point, the Dragon Emperor suddenly became a tyrant. He tried to offer his son's betrothed, a princess of an allied country, as a sacrifice to a demon.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: He also intended to start a war to conquer every nation on Jiendia, using demonic power...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Prince Guiyi rose to stop his father's tyranny and chose to sacrifice himself. He activated the Barrier of Time and isolated this place from the present world forever, knowing what that choice meant for him...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Then, one day after four hundred years, the barrier broke. As if someone had done it deliberately... Since the army has awakened and begun moving, the Dragon Emperor must have awakened too.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: We must find whoever broke the barrier, and defeat the Dragon Emperor and his army, as we could not in the past. That is what I, who live bound by time, must do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will taking down the palace take a long time? You seem very short-handed...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Many of the empire's people are deployed on other operations.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: And above all, this is a personal matter of old debts and grudges that I must settle myself...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: That's why I came to Yong Gyoung with only the small force available at once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It sounds difficult...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What can I do?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Please defeat the Yong Gyoung troops defending the palace. A few elite soldiers have infiltrated it, but I can't be certain they'll succeed...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Of course I trust our soldiers, but this place needs someone with unusual strength. Someone like you...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Please help deal with the defensive troops around the palace.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll try.

steps.name: Deal with Trouble Quickly!
steps.objective: Defeat [Yong Gyoung Swordsmen] and [Yong Gyoung Archers], then report to Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: ...We've received some unusual intelligence that you should hear.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: One report says the defeated Yong Gyoung soldiers carried 'magic stones' containing faint magical energy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic stones...?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: As you know, the army's strength is no longer that of ordinary humans. The stones they carry are probably the reason.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: We need to obtain some stones and examine them. We must discover the secret of their strength...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic stones that increase strength... What could they be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I gather them for you?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Please do, %s...

steps.name: A Strange Object
steps.objective: Defeat [Elite Swordsmen] and [Elite Archers], then bring back the <Suspicious Magic Stones>.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: So this is the magic stone in question...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Oh dear... The energy inside it is too faint. Has all its power already been absorbed?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: It will be difficult to analyze in this state.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wouldn't a stronger being have a stronger magic stone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That might be possible... In that case...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are there any particularly strong members of the Yong Gyoung army?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If there are, I should defeat them and bring their stones back.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Hmm, one moment. Ah, there are.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The Beast Riders who guard the palace's outer grounds. They should be at least twice as strong as ordinary Yong Gyoung soldiers.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: They ride beasts and command the defensive lines... Be careful. Both the soldiers and their mounts have received demonic power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'll be careful.

steps.name: Studying Magic Stone Patterns
steps.objective: Defeat [Beast Soldiers] and obtain the <Powerful Magic Stones>, then report to Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The stone's pattern is difficult... More precisely, my knowledge isn't enough to understand it.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I thought I was reasonably familiar with magic, but seeing this stone made me doubt that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What part is difficult, exactly?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The way the magical formula's circuits are arranged inside it. Normally, when mages construct such circuits...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, but could you explain it a little more simply?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Yes. Let me try again.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The way the magic engraved in this stone is activated is extremely unusual, so it's difficult to analyze.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: It doesn't seem to follow an ordinary structure...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should we do?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: We'll need help from someone well versed in this kind of magic.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Lady Leilei, the Tiger Immortal inside the palace...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: She should know something. Please ask her.

steps.name: A Powerful Magic Stone
steps.objective: Deliver the <Powerful Magic Stones> to Leilei in "Dragon Emperor's Palace".

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Jiendia told you to show this to me? Hmm, what is it?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I'm not a specialist in magical arts like Jeril, so magical theory is a bit difficult for me.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: But you never know. I'll take a look!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Let's see... Hmm!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: (Leilei lets out a heavy sigh.)

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: This foul pattern... It's right on the tip of my memory. I've definitely seen it somewhere, but I can't remember.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Perhaps too much time has passed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Still, I have my dignity as an immortal. Wait a moment. Hrrm... Hrrm...

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Just a little. It will only take a little while. Wait. Just a moment.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I said!!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: You there, help me while I examine this. It's too noisy around here to concentrate. Just help me a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Simple, simple, very simple. Drive out the villains inside here while I concentrate. Just for a moment. Easy, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, if it's only a moment...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suddenly feel dizzy...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Am I imagining it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Leilei, I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: O-oh. You looked unwell just now. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. I'll buy you as much time as I can, so please try to remember anything you know about the stones!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: All right. Be careful, understood?

steps.name: While the Memories Return
steps.objective: Defeat [Yong Gyoung Generals] and [Yong Gyoung Spearmen], then report to Leilei.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Phew. I've been waiting. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The soldiers in the palace really were different. They moved unlike ordinary humans...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who could have made those magic stones?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: An Agasura. The distinctive arrangement of magical circuits engraved in this stone is definitely Agasura work. I guarantee it! But... Hmm... Something's strange.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I've seen Agasura formulas before. They were far removed from normal forms. Even immortals couldn't tamper with them. Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? I'm a little doubtful.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Power beyond even an immortal's reach... Believe me.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: A boundary even other immortals cannot ignore... It can only be the Agasura! Agasura!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Agasura...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why would an Agasura be here, and what were they doing?)

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: You're not doubting my abilities, are you? Oh, right. There's something I forgot to say.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Jiendia suddenly went farther into the palace!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: She asked me to send you to her as soon as you arrived. She left signs along the way, so she said you'd find her easily.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: You're probably the only one who can see them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: When she met you, she probably placed some kind of spell on you for your safety. So don't be suspicious!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Jiendia doesn't want anyone else getting hurt because of her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because of her...? Oh, and I wasn't being suspicious.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: All right, all right. You're going straight to Jiendia, then?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Since she's looking for me, I'll go.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Jiendia is complicated. She has a lot of history.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Perhaps you might be able to understand her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go to Her Majesty and tell her exactly what you said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything else you want to tell her?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Not right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... I'll pass on what you've told me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Agasura...)

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I'll stay here and do my best to follow the plan with the soldiers. Be careful, all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll go inside. You be careful too.

steps.name: Agasura's Magic Pattern
steps.objective: Talk to [Leilei], then find Jiendia in "Dragon Emperor's Palace".

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I've already heard the general outline from Lady Leilei.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: To be honest, I had my suspicions too... So it really was made by an Agasura.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Lady Leilei is extraordinary! To understand even this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You trust her a great deal.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Of course. Anyway, now that we have a clearer picture of who broke the barrier, I think we can resolve this.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Once we defeat the master of the palace, everything should end. Surely...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: But there's something we must do first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Something very important.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Our troops who entered Moonflower Garden have gone missing.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The garden's space-time axis seems to have twisted, leaving its paths in chaos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Its space-time axis...?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Yes. The barrier is the cause.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Moonflower Garden was long famous for its abundant, pure energy.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: While the Barrier of Time cut the palace off from the outside world, energy kept accumulating. The moment the barrier was lifted, that energy erupted.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: We can only assume that this affected space and time.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: ...That was a little complicated, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a little hard to understand. Could you tell me exactly what I need to do?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Check whether the Master of Moonflower Garden is also under the influence of a magic stone.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: If the master isn't in his right mind, he must never be allowed outside.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: A large magical formation in the garden gathers energy from outside...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: And the Master of Moonflower Garden is at its center.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Defeating him should collapse the axis and dismantle the formation. Then the distorted flow of space and time should slowly settle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow. That's impressive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know all this?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Prince Guiyi told me himself.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Ah, we have no time. Our soldiers keep falling, so we must hurry.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: ...Please help.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I don't expect defeating the master alone to restore things immediately. I'll gather information and look for a way to resolve it too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going. Please be careful.

steps.name: Distorted Space
steps.objective: Defeat the [Moonflower Garden Master], then report to Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I expected it, but the garden's master really was controlled by a magic stone...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: It's tragic. He was a warm person whose love of flowers reflected his heart...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Now that he's gone, the garden's distorted space and time should soon return to normal.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Then it's time to go to the place where this tragedy began.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I'm fine. Let me tell you about the Dragon Emperor's Hall. It is where the emperor who made this place what it is now resides.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: To preserve his royal authority, he became so suspicious and afraid of even his own son...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: He sought out Lux, lord of the demon realm, and wagered his soul in the bargain. A pathetic, unworthy ruler who believed that as a fallen dragon, he could devour everything...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: And there is also a great man there who sacrificed even himself to stop that fallen dragon.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Prince Guiyi... Though perhaps he is no longer a crown prince.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (As Jiendia's gaze wavers, a soldier runs toward her from the distance, looking distressed.)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 제국 정규군 1
lines.text: Your Majesty! Lady Leilei requests reinforcements! The Dragon Emperor's forces are trying to escape, and she is holding them back with the remaining troops!

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Understood. %s, we must end our conversation. I have one more request, as the ruler of a nation, however small...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: The palace entrance should be relatively clear now. Go inside, confront that foolish emperor, and bring him down. Then bring me the magic stone he carries.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I'll help Lady Leilei in the meantime. Ending the fallen dragon is the only way to sever everything bound at the boundary of time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A fallen dragon... the boundary of time... It's complicated, but it's something I have to do...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Thank you, %s...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (Perhaps you are...)

steps.name: Where the Tragedy Began
steps.objective: Defeat [Tam] in the "Dragon Emperor's Hall" and obtain <Tam's Magic Stone>, then report to [Guiyi] inside the "Dragon Emperor's Hall".

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Who's there? Identify yourself.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: No, more importantly, I...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Why am I still alive? To stop my father after he became a dragon, I surely used the secret art passed down through the royal family...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I activated the Great Miracle Secret Art, the barrier called 'Stopped Time.'

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: And I too became trapped inside... Yes, I remember.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: But... but... Urgh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Guiyi is in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, Prince Guiyi?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right? I'd like to give you some medicine...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I'm sorry I cannot accept your kindness. This isn't pain medicine can heal...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: This is the backlash caused by my spirit and body being forcibly separated... Someone did this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Guiyi, did you see the people who removed the palace's barrier and used the magic stones?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Leilei says it was the work of the Agasura...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: W-wait. Did you say Jiendia? Her Majesty? Then she has become an empress?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you mean the time since the palace was sealed... About four hundred years have passed.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Four hundred years?! Th-then what of the Yong Gyoung Empire?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's gone. The Jiendia continent is now governed by the Kingdom of Elias and several other powers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She is leading troops to hold back the awakened palace, so the beings inside cannot escape...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, does that mean Her Majesty is over four hundred years old...?)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: She's alive. Yes, she's alive and well. My time stopped, but hers continued...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: My father, the tyrant emperor, was consumed by the delusion that I would overthrow him. He must have thought I was raising an army to seize power.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Somewhere, he found Lux, lord of the demon realm, and sold his soul. In return, he gained power and became a fallen dragon.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: In the end, that too was according to Lux's wishes... To summon Lux to this land, the emperor abducted my betrothed, Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: He offered her as a sacrifice on the altar, intending to use her power to let Lux appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying Her Majesty has divine blood?

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I cannot say precisely, but I understand such beings are called Demigods.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Only she, with divine blood, could serve as a vessel capable of containing Lux, who holds part of the demon realm's power.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: By the time I learned the truth, the ritual was already halfway complete.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: With the help of a bodyguard I regarded as family, I managed to save Jiendia... But I never imagined she would become someone forced to endure such a long span of time.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Perhaps Jiendia... Jiendia...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: (Guiyi, who had been speaking calmly, suddenly looks sorrowful.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Guiyi, then... what happened afterward?

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Ah, forgive me. I lost my train of thought. I had no strength. Even what strength I had was insufficient to stop the fallen dragon whose soul had been consumed by darkness.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: The empire was already in turmoil because of the emperor's tyranny. If a fallen dragon appeared amid that...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I couldn't bear to watch. Not the collapse of the land where we had lived for our people for so long...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: When the fallen dragon appeared before me, I made my choice. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I did hope my bodyguard would unravel the tangled threads of fate...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's what happened...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I miss Jiendia...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I will trust you. Go and tell her that, just as she endured, I too will hold on however I can and find a way to return to my original body.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'll tell her. But please meet her yourself someday and say it to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, did you see the being who removed the barrier and engraved the magic stones?

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Thinking of Jiendia made me forget your question. I'm sorry. He shouted about how glad he was to have become an Agasura. Ah, those sharp eyes... Once seen, they were impossible to forget.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: That's all I remember. Hurry and tell her. I hope it will help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. So... you must see Her Majesty again...

steps.name: A Conversation with Prince Guiyi
steps.objective: Talk to Jiendia in "Dragon Emperor's Palace".

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: %s, i-is that true?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Prince Guiyi is really... really alive?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said his body and soul were forcibly separated and cannot return to their proper places.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And he said the culprit was an Agasura man with long red hair and piercing eyes.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: What? A man with long red hair? Among the Agasura I know, there is no one like that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A new Agasura...)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I think I must postpone seeing Prince Guiyi a little longer. I'll look into this myself.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Did you bring Tam's magic stone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is he called Tam?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: In the language of the Yong Gyoung Empire, it means 'fallen dragon.' They say fallen dragons existed in the past too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Show Tam's magic stone to Lady Leilei.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: She knows so much. If she sees that enormous stone, she'll surely be able to tell us about the unidentified Agasura man too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Agasura man...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. I'll go see her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her Majesty's expression is so complicated...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why did that being Lux want to come here...?)

steps.name: Analysis Results
steps.objective: Deliver <Tam's Magic Stone> to Leilei in "Dragon Emperor's Palace".

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Yaaawn! It looks like everything has gone well. Can I head home now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Leilei!

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Ugh. I was trying to slip away without Jiendia catching me...

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: No helping it. Sigh... %s, what is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you look so bothered?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: The major work is done, and I'd like to rest... Anyway, hurry up and tell me. This Tiger Immortal wants to go home and relax!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her Majesty told me to show you this magic stone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hand Leilei the magic stone.)

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Did she?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Jiendia really does have an eye for people... no, for immortals.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: What's wrong with you?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: You look strange. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Probably the aftereffects of the battle. I think I'll be fine after some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: O-oh, really?

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: All right. Then I'll examine it.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: This magic stone... is strange. Usually a stone is given only one attribute, but this one has more than the distinctive energy of the Agasura...

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I can sense the demon realm in it too...

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: What does this mean? We haven't detected any movements from Lux recently. Demon-realm energy in an Agasura's magic stone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So there is something behind it.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: Hurry and tell Jiendia that something is wrong. If Lux and another Agasura have joined forces, we're certainly in trouble.

lines.speaker: 레이레이
lines.text: I'll return and investigate what's happening.

steps.name: The Secret of the Magic Stones
steps.objective: Talk to Jiendia in "Dragon Emperor's Palace".

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (Jiendia is visibly surprised by Leilei's findings.)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: What Agasura would dare do this...?

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Could it be Choen Palm, the Agasura I've only heard rumors about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, Choen Palm has already...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: (After hearing a brief account of Choen Palm, Jiendia looks as though she understands.)

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: %s, I understand. As soon as we've finished clearing the palace, I'll return and establish an investigation team.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: May I ask for your help when needed?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to find a girl named Iris.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Ah, I've heard that you're looking for her. If our investigation turns up any clue to Iris's whereabouts, I'll tell you immediately.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Then perhaps Guiyi too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Your Majesty. I'll wait to hear from you.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: Thank you, %s. We have much to do.

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: We must find the Agasura man with long red hair and discover what Lux is plotting...

lines.speaker: 지엔디아
lines.text: I'll contact you soon. Please wait for my message.
